Is it really free?
Yes. Every game on the site is free to play, and there is nothing to buy. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter. You open a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. The games run in your browser and start instantly, with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, for many games. Lots of them are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category. Games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn your phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse and say so on their page.
Is it safe for my kids?
The site accepts family-friendly games only, with no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are collected in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Yes, but only in your own browser. Recently played games, favourites, the light or dark choice and most games' own progress stay on your device and never leave it. If you clear your browser data or play in private mode, they are lost.
A game will not load. What can I do?
If it still does not start, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and tell us which game it is. We will look into it.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, the studio behind the site. The rest are licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, or sent in directly by 23 independent developers. Games are never copied from other portals.
I made a game. Can I add it to the site?

Yes, it is free and non-exclusive. Send it at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/ and a real person will play it. If it is accepted, it gets its own page that credits you and links back to you, while the game stays on your own server.
How do I get my game removed?
Email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will take it down. You can ask for this at any time.
Can I put a game on my own website?
For the site's own games, yes. Each has an "Embed this game" box on its page with ready-made code. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so we cannot offer embed code for them.
How do I reach a real person?
Write to contact@ilovewebgames.com. Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia, runs the site.
